loc: A header or footer of your own
text: One button, with `kit.Button`, to the one destination for the offer.

loc: A header or footer of your own
text: Keep it short. A header is one row: logos, the account line, the menu, the button. A footer is the seller's mark, the legal line and the legal links.
Props are content: plain text, brand choices (surface, heading role), images from brand/brand.md.

loc: A header or footer of your own
text: The seller's logo: `kit.Image` with a logo file from brand/brand.md.

A new section is one small React file built only from the brand's tokens. … Write whatever structure the page needs — steps, grids, comparisons, image and text — as long as every colour, type size, corner and button comes from the brand.
Style only with the brand's classes … No colour values, pixel sizes, `style` or `className` props: write_section refuses them.
Make it look like the seller's sections around it. Render and compare.

loc: A header or footer of your own
text: Build it from the brand … Look at the seller's own header (its nav band in `catalog/`) and follow its layout and spacing. It must look like the seller's site, never like a generic header with their logo dropped in.
Motion: add a class from brand/brand.md (Motion) to an element … Write no transition or animation of your own.
note: M1.2/M1.3: rebuilding the seller's own motion is allowed; homed in family 3.

text: Use when you have been asked to add something that no clone and no brand section can carry.
note: R4.3 order: clone slots → rebuilt clone → brand section → own section; the agent decides, it need not be asked.

text: The kit gives you these pieces, with exactly these props: kit.Shell … kit.Button … kit.Link … kit.Card … kit.Eyebrow … kit.Image … Motion: add a class from brand/brand.md
note: No video piece: a rebuilt or written section cannot carry the seller's video (R11.1, M1.2).
